description: RS256 on a set of oct keys only fails with NoMatchingKey; decided by ADR 0054 §2.1 (family): no oct key serves RS256, so a secret key is never returned for an asymmetric alg (§7, RFC 8725 §3.1) and zero members match (§4); outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
